title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - DangerousGoods
description: Kind of dangerous goods being carried by a heavy vehicle (s4auto:DangerousGoods). Narrower kinds are defined per the `class`/`division` definitions of part II, chapter 2.1.1.1 of the European Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Road (ADR).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DangerousGoods'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

dangerousGoodsKind.description: Property. Kind of dangerous goods carried (s4auto:DangerousGoods_*).

dangerousGoodsCompany.description: Property. Company that manages the transportation of the dangerous goods (s4auto:hasDangerousGoodsCompany).

dangerousGoodsPhone.description: Property. Contact phone number of the assistance service in case of incident or accident, as a tel: URI per RFC 3966 (s4auto:hasDangerousGoodsPhone).

dangerousGoodsUnNumber.description: Property. UN number identifying the substance, per the UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods - Model Regulations (s4auto:hasDangerousGoodsUnNumber).

dangerousGoodsEmergencyActionCode.description: Property. Physical signage placard code on the vehicle informing how an emergency service should deal with an incident (s4auto:hasDangerousGoodsEmergencyActionCode).

elevatedTemperature.description: Property. TRUE if the carried dangerous goods are transported at high temperature (s4auto:ElevatedTemperature).

tunnelsRestricted.description: Property. TRUE if the heavy vehicle carrying the dangerous goods is restricted from entering tunnels (s4auto:TunnelsRestricted).

limitedQuantity.description: Property. TRUE if the carried dangerous goods are packed with limited quantity (s4auto:LimitedQuantity).

carriedByVehicle.description: Relationship. The Vehicle carrying these dangerous goods (inverse of s4auto:Vehicle saref:consistsOf DangerousGoods).
